verdict.rationale: A documented programmatic API is a fair question for a package manager, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents only the official CLI (nix build, nix develop, nix run, and so on), which belongs to a separate story. Probes for OpenAPI or Swagger specs all returned 404, and no library or HTTP API is documented, so there is no evidence the product can be driven through a public API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
